related.title: PETSc CSR SpMV：稀疏索引與零元素
related.titleEn: PETSc CSR SpMV: sparse indices and omitted zeros
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付DGEMM介面表、小矩陣黃金答案與β回歸；27/22與手算一致，矩陣形狀、轉置旗標及stride可重建；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver DGEMM contracts, small-matrix golden outputs and beta regressions. Verify 27/22 and reconstruct shapes, transpose flags and strides. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫rowptr[0]=0、rowptr[1]=2與兩個非零；用稠密列[2,0,−1]對照；1/−1正確，rowptr單調、末值等於nnz且列索引在向量範圍。
related.differenceEn: Draw rowptr [0] = 0 and rowptr [1] = 2 with two nonzero entries. Compare the dense row [2, 0, −1]. Verify 1/−1, monotonic rowptr, last=nnz and valid column bounds.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: C=αAB+βC0；對同一元素先做內積，再套α與β，不能省略舊C項；A第一列[1,2]，B第一行向量列為[3,4]，C0(0,0)=5；α2，β1；改β0；名義式 2*(1*3+2*4)+1*5 = 27 C(0,0)；變更式 2*(1*3+2*4) = 22 C(0,0)。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
CSR一列y_i=sum values[k]×x[col[k]]；rowptr界定半開區間，零可不儲存；第0列col=[0,2]、values=[2,−1]，x=[3,4,5]；將x2改7；名義式 2*3-1*5 = 1 y[0]；變更式 2*3-1*7 = -1 y[0]。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: C=αAB+βC 0; compute the dot product before applying α/β, and retain the old C term. A row 0=[1, 2], B column 0=[3, 4], C0(0, 0)=5, alpha 2, beta 1; compare beta 0. Nominal 2*(1*3+2*4)+1*5 = 27 C(0, 0); changed 2*(1*3+2*4) = 22 C(0, 0). Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

CSR row y_i sums values[k] x[col[k]] over a rowptr half-open interval; zeros may be omitted. Row 0 columns [0, 2], values [2, −1], x [3, 4, 5]; change x 2 to 7. Nominal 2*3-1*5 = 1 y[0]; changed 2*3-1*7 = -1 y[0]. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Barnes–Hut：遠場接受準則與誤差驗證
related.titleEn: Barnes–Hut: far-field acceptance and error checks
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付DGEMM介面表、小矩陣黃金答案與β回歸；27/22與手算一致，矩陣形狀、轉置旗標及stride可重建；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver DGEMM contracts, small-matrix golden outputs and beta regressions. Verify 27/22 and reconstruct shapes, transpose flags and strides. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫目標粒子、群集邊界與質心，標s和d的定義；近距群必須展開；.2接受、.4展開，報告另有直接力參考與誤差定義。
related.differenceEn: Draw the target, cluster bounds, and center of mass. Define s and d explicitly and open nearby groups. Accept 0.2 and open 0.4. Include an independent direct-force reference and explicit error definition.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: C=αAB+βC0；對同一元素先做內積，再套α與β，不能省略舊C項；A第一列[1,2]，B第一行向量列為[3,4]，C0(0,0)=5；α2，β1；改β0；名義式 2*(1*3+2*4)+1*5 = 27 C(0,0)；變更式 2*(1*3+2*4) = 22 C(0,0)。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
簡化接受量s/d，若s/d<θ才以群集近似；此幾何條件不直接等於力誤差；合成群寬s2、距離d10，θ.25；變更d5，保持s與θ；名義式 2/10 = 0.2 opening ratio；變更式 2/5 = 0.4 opening ratio。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: C=αAB+βC 0; compute the dot product before applying α/β, and retain the old C term. A row 0=[1, 2], B column 0=[3, 4], C0(0, 0)=5, alpha 2, beta 1; compare beta 0. Nominal 2*(1*3+2*4)+1*5 = 27 C(0, 0); changed 2*(1*3+2*4) = 22 C(0, 0). Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

The simplified rule accepts a group when s/d < θ. This geometric ratio is not a direct bound on force error. Synthetic group size s = 2, distance d = 10, θ = 0.25; compare d = 5 with fixed s and θ. Nominal 2/10 = 0.2 opening ratio; changed 2/5 = 0.4 opening ratio. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
